title: My go-to Marine Weather App
body: I boat and surf all over the world and check Buoyweather daily. It's amazing. The new app is way better and very easy to use. When I'm home in the US - I prefer Buoyweather over NOAA due to how easy they make it to get point forecasts out to 100nm. You can't really do that with NWS/NOAA...and is worth paying for premium. Looking forward to when they add more detailed wave info.

title: Always Checking It

title: Great Improvement
body: Really enjoying the new version of Buoyweather. Being able to set favorites makes life way easier. I also love the point-based tides. No more need for nearest tied station. The overall user interface is very easy to navigate and the forecasts seem more accurate than ever here in the Southeast.

title: My new favorite app . . .
body: Recently discovered Buoyweather through a friend and couldn't be more satisfied. I love the simplicity of the tool and have come to trust this app to give me an accurate look at both current and future ocean conditions. I would definitely recommend it to others who frequent more out-of-the-way locations that might not be covered by competing services.
